engine.description: Core analytic engine containing the heuristic baseline (anomaly_generator.py), deterministic causality mapping (diagnostics.py), packet processing (diagnose_packet.py), and local feedback ingest (feedback.py).

project_handoff_summary.description: Executive handoff summarizing project milestones, conclusions regarding the LSTM vs baseline, and SOC integration prerequisites.

operational_limitations.description: Documentation of current system constraints including zero-day bias, threshold saturation, and the lack of automated unlearning.

signal_attribution.description: Empirical breakdown of which components drive Track A and Track B scores across the top dataset slices.

diagnosed_review_packet.description: The canonical output for the SOC analyst. Contains the dual-queue Track A and the session-based Track B anomalies, enriched with human-readable causal explanations.

raw_track_a_csv.description: Raw CSV containing the top 20 total-score and top 20 context-inconsistency CorrelationId anomalies.

raw_track_b_csv.description: Raw CSV containing the top 20 caller session drift anomalies.

feedback_database.description: Local SQLite database for SOC analysts to log CONFIRMED_ANOMALY or BENIGN_FALSE_POSITIVE labels against generated outputs.
